Prototype definition: Five OHM historical features beside modern map; toggle two dates
Evidence / success test: Can a test user identify one unexpected historical change in 2 minutes?
Outcome / notes: 4 Nov 2026: owner confirmed public first playable at https://time-layer.corneliuslobster.workers.dev/ and reported useful but clunky. Source: https://github.com/241443Mooks/Time-layer . Timeline controls expanded to approximately 4000 BCE (code committed; live redeployment not independently verified). Still uses independent OHM/OSM embeds; no five verified historical features or two-minute user validation yet. 4 Nov: v0.2 historical evidence inspector committed (bounded 150-record OHM query, source/date caveats, clickable recorded dates, collapsed panel on mobile). Live page and /api/evidence?view=centre endpoint externally confirmed 4 Nov; endpoint returned 150 OHM records and hit the cap. Browser interaction and wider viewpoint/date/source QA still pending. 4 Nov: selected-year filter committed; no later features or future event jumps in earlier years; start-year evidence required. 4 Nov: improved OHM time-window retrieval is live (25-year server-side interval, cap applied after filter, cache by viewpoint and period). First Historic England Scheduled Monuments source is now integrated as optional Castlefield-only research layer; endpoint returned Roman fort eastern wall NHLE 1001953. Not yet attributed to the selected year: designation date is not site age. 4 Nov v0.3: world place-first UI now live. Wikidata search returns coordinate-bearing worldwide locations; linked Wikipedia summaries/nearby articles power exploratory trails. One manually sourced Castlefield (Q2308772) to Mamucium (Q3285089) relationship tested, keeping 79 CE and breadcrumb path; place-specific OHM historical API live. No year-filtering claim for Wikipedia connections and no independently tested mobile UX. 4 Nov v0.4: a single Past/Today map switch replaced two vertically stacked maps; controls observed live, mocked no-reload interaction passed, but panning remains unsynchronised. 4 Nov v0.5: user liked mobile flip but noted unsynchronised pan. Added opt-in Keep views aligned beta using single MapLibre v5.6 camera, OHM v2 date plugin and OSM raster layer; center/zoom preserved across flips in mocked tests; legacy embeds remain fallback. Beta live rendering on user's handset not yet verified. Added archive viewer links for genuine old maps (not embedded); promoted sourced Castlefield→Mamucium lead into a visible card. Tested TNA Discovery API (51 catalogue hits for Castlefield Manchester), documented as a possible next archival connector, not yet integrated. 5 Nov v0.6: real phone screenshot prompted compact collapsible place/year controls, optional fold-away map, condensed Wikipedia context and a Commons-verified image-led Warren: credited hero, featured Mamucium photo and nearby image cards. Castlefield media licences (CC BY/SA and Commons file pages) verified through live API; markup and simulated interactions checked, real-device feel still to be confirmed. Name disambiguation risk: London Bridge station differs from historic London Bridge 1209–1831. 6 Nov v0.7: Commons source images require verified creation dates near selected year (20yr pilot, exact gap disclosed); dynamic bounded historical artwork search with licensed source files/ranking. Modern station 2018 photo hidden for 1735. Curated precise 1746 London Bridge map sheet (London Picture Archive record 33549) links only for historic bridge Q56739974 within 15yr (1746 is 11yr after 1735); generic archive directories removed. Station Q801125 and old bridge are separate identities with a period-relevant exploration lead. First source selection/ranking model and verified map item registry: https://github.com/241443Mooks/Time-layer/blob/main/docs/source-matching.md . 6 Nov v0.8: moved discovery warren before the optional map, added same-place ±25/100-year time hops and user-triggered 4-chip named OHM date samples without opening the long evidence panel; nested date record, stats and caveat disclosures with in-site record exploration, no more building=yes as title. Commons century and bounded-period image dates retain uncertainty (17th century=1601–1700, not 1800), lower-ranked than exact years. Real-device mobile UX remains to verify. 6 Nov v0.9: source-backed Tower of London Q62378 chronology (Roman on-site context vs Norman build, seven tappable chapters from HRP/Historic England) and anonymous UK house research demo (four distinct evidence-gathering methods; no property dates invented). Unknown places explicitly lack a verified chronology. Adaptive history API and compact mobile swipe cards live.
